BullionRates.title: BullionRates
BullionRates.description: Live daily wholesale rates for 24K Gold, 22K Gold, and 999 Fine Silver published by the owner.

gold24kPer10g.description: 24K (999) Gold wholesale rate in INR per 10 grams.

gold22kPer10g.description: 22K (916 BIS) Gold wholesale rate in INR per 10 grams.

silverPerKg.description: Pure 999 Fine Silver wholesale rate in INR per kilogram.

silverPer10g.description: Pure 999 Fine Silver wholesale rate in INR per 10 grams.

gstNote.description: Display note stating GST applicability at billing.

marketNote.description: Optional brief wholesale desk remark from the owner.

updatedByLabel.description: Public non-PII attribution label such as Managing Director.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest rate update.

RateHistoryEntry.title: RateHistoryEntry
RateHistoryEntry.description: Audit log entry for manual owner rate updates.

/rates/{rateId}.description: Stores live wholesale bullion rates under document ID 'live'.

/rateHistory/{entryId}.description: Append-only owner audit trail of manual rate updates.
